category.description: Category of the provisioning error. Note: Currently, there is only one possible value. Possible value: PropertyConflict - indicates a property value is not unique. Other objects contain the same value for the property.

occurredDateTime.description: The date and time at which the error occurred.

propertyCausingError.description: Name of the directory property causing the error. Current possible values: UserPrincipalName or ProxyAddress

value.description: Value of the property causing the error.
